memories.content: The Academic Senate is the governing body of Ashvale University responsible for academic policy. It has a chair, a secretary, and voting members including faculty representatives from each department. The senate has received a motion to adopt pass-fail grading for the current academic year. Members have varying opinions on the motion, but no formal vote has been taken yet.

Ashvale University's academic senate will hold its October plenary meeting on 2026-10-15. The agenda includes a motion to adopt pass-fail grading for the current academic year. The motion was introduced by a faculty member and has been reviewed by the curriculum committee, which recommended sending it back to committee for further study. The senate can vote to pass, reject, or send back to committee.
